name: Texas Railroad Commission Rules
description: TX RRC regulates drilling, production, pipelines. Permissive environment enables rapid development.
market_impact_summary: TX produces ~30% of US gas, ~40% of US oil. Fast permitting enables supply response.

name: Natural Gas Act Section 7 - Pipeline Certificates
description: Requires FERC certificate for interstate pipeline construction and operation.
market_impact_summary: Controls pace of pipeline development. Provides eminent domain upon approval.

name: Natural Gas Act Section 3 - LNG Export Authority
description: Requires DOE authorization for LNG exports. FTA countries automatic. Non-FTA needs public interest finding.
market_impact_summary: Framework for US LNG exports. ~50 Bcf/d approved capacity.

name: National Environmental Policy Act
description: Requires environmental impact statements for major federal actions including pipelines.
market_impact_summary: Creates multi-year permitting timeline. EIS can take 4-7 years for major pipelines.

name: FERC Order 436 - Open Access Transportation
description: First major step toward open-access gas transportation. Began unbundling of merchant and transportation functions.
market_impact_summary: Began transition from regulated wellhead prices to market-based pricing.

name: Clean Air Act Amendments of 1990
description: Established SO2 cap-and-trade. First market-based emissions trading program.
market_impact_summary: Required scrubbers or fuel switching. Began shift to low-sulfur coal and gas.

name: FERC Order 636 - Pipeline Restructuring
description: Required interstate pipelines to unbundle sales from transportation. Created modern competitive gas market.
market_impact_summary: Completed transition to competitive wholesale gas markets. Henry Hub emerged as pricing point.

name: FERC Order 888 - Electric Open Access
description: Required public utilities to provide open-access transmission services. Foundation for ISOs.
market_impact_summary: Enabled wholesale electricity markets and competitive power generation.

name: FERC Certificate Policy Statement
description: Framework for evaluating pipeline certificate applications. Balances need vs impacts.
market_impact_summary: Enabled ~95% approval rate 2000-2020. Currently under review for climate impacts.

name: FERC Order 2000 - RTO Formation
description: Encouraged formation of Regional Transmission Organizations to operate grids and markets.
market_impact_summary: Created organized wholesale markets (PJM, MISO, SPP, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE).

name: Energy Policy Act 2005 - Fracking Exemption
description: Exempted hydraulic fracturing from Safe Drinking Water Act. Removed barrier to shale development.
market_impact_summary: Enabled shale gas revolution. US production: 18 Tcf (2005) to 34 Tcf (2023). Transformed US to net exporter.

name: Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative
description: First mandatory US cap-and-trade for CO2. 11 Northeast states.
market_impact_summary: Carbon price $13-15/ton. Accelerated coal retirements. $6B+ revenue.

name: Sabine Pass LNG Export Authorization
description: First DOE authorization for LNG exports to non-FTA countries. Landmark decision.
market_impact_summary: Opened global markets. First cargo Feb 2016. Transformed US from importer to exporter.

name: FERC Order 1000 - Transmission Planning
description: Reformed transmission planning to consider public policy requirements and remove ROFR.
market_impact_summary: Improved regional transmission planning. Increased competition for transmission development.

name: California Cap-and-Trade
description: California economy-wide cap-and-trade. Covers electricity, industrial, fuels.
market_impact_summary: Carbon price $30-35/ton. Eliminated in-state coal. Linked with Quebec.

name: Pennsylvania Act 13 - Marcellus Regulation
description: Comprehensive Marcellus Shale regulation. Impact fees, setbacks, environmental standards.
market_impact_summary: Created framework for largest US shale play. PA: 1 Tcf (2010) to 7 Tcf (2023).

name: Cross-State Air Pollution Rule
description: Addresses interstate SO2 and NOx transport. Covers 28 eastern states.
market_impact_summary: Additional coal retirement driver. Updated multiple times with tighter limits.

name: Mercury and Air Toxics Standards
description: First national standards for mercury and toxics from power plants.
market_impact_summary: Major coal retirement driver. 15-20 GW coal retired partly due to MATS.

name: New York Fracking Prohibition
description: Permanent ban on high-volume hydraulic fracturing in New York State.
market_impact_summary: Prevented NY Marcellus development. Increased dependence on pipeline imports.

name: New Mexico Energy Transition Act
description: 100% carbon-free by 2045. Enabled San Juan GS securitization.
market_impact_summary: San Juan GS retired 2022. PNM transitioning remaining coal.

name: Colorado SB 19-181 - Oil & Gas Reform
description: Reformed CO oil & gas regulation to prioritize public health. Local government control.
market_impact_summary: Increased regulatory uncertainty in DJ Basin. Some capital shifted to Permian.

name: Colorado Clean Energy Plan
description: Xcel: 80% carbon reduction by 2030, 100% clean by 2050.
market_impact_summary: Xcel retiring all CO coal by 2030. Template for utility decarbonization.

name: Texas SB 3 - Grid Reliability
description: Post-Uri weatherization requirements for generation and gas facilities.
market_impact_summary: Increased compliance costs. Aims to prevent Uri repeat.

name: Illinois Climate and Equitable Jobs Act
description: Coal by 2030, gas by 2045, 100% clean by 2050. Largest state coal phaseout.
market_impact_summary: Retiring ~6 GW coal in MISO by 2030. Creates reliability challenges.

name: Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act
description: $1.2T infrastructure including $65B grid, $8B H2 hubs, $12B CCS.
market_impact_summary: Addresses infrastructure bottlenecks. Complements IRA incentives.

name: Inflation Reduction Act - Clean Energy
description: Largest US climate investment. Extended PTC/ITC, new 45V hydrogen, 45Q CCS credits.
market_impact_summary: $369B clean energy incentives. Transforms clean energy economics.

name: Carbon Capture Tax Credit
description: $85/ton geologic storage, $60/ton EOR, $180/ton DAC.
market_impact_summary: Makes CCS viable for many applications. Enables blue hydrogen.

name: Clean Hydrogen Production Tax Credit
description: Up to $3/kg for clean hydrogen based on carbon intensity. Four tiers.
market_impact_summary: $3/kg credit makes green hydrogen competitive with grey.

name: Washington Cap-and-Invest
description: Washington economy-wide cap-and-trade. Second state after California.
market_impact_summary: Carbon price $48-63/ton, highest in US. Adds cost to WA power and fuels.

name: Minnesota 100% Clean Electricity
description: 100% carbon-free by 2040. Earliest Midwest clean target.
market_impact_summary: Accelerates Xcel coal retirements. Drives renewable procurement.

name: Mountain Valley Pipeline Congressional Approval
description: Debt ceiling bill directed completion of MVP, overriding court challenges.
market_impact_summary: Enabled 303-mile, 2 Bcf/d pipeline. First Congressional pipeline approval. In service 2024.

name: Good Neighbor Ozone Rule
description: Updated CSAPR for 2015 ozone NAAQS. Requires NOx reductions in 23 states.
market_impact_summary: Supreme Court partially stayed. Where effective, accelerates coal retirement.

name: Regional Clean Hydrogen Hubs
description: $7B for 7 regional hydrogen hubs covering production, storage, transport, end-use.
market_impact_summary: Creates regional hydrogen ecosystems. Expected 3M MT/year production.

name: Texas Energy Fund
description: $10B fund for low-interest loans for new dispatchable generation.
market_impact_summary: Major incentive for new gas. Could support 10+ GW capacity.

name: Methane Emissions Charge
description: First federal methane fee. $900/ton (2024), $1,200/ton (2025), $1,500/ton (2026+).
market_impact_summary: Creates direct cost for methane emissions. Incentivizes leak detection.

name: DOE LNG Export Authorization Pause
description: Paused new non-FTA LNG authorizations pending economic and environmental review update.
market_impact_summary: Created uncertainty for ~10 Bcf/d proposed. Existing approvals unaffected.

name: EPA Oil and Gas Methane Rule
description: First comprehensive federal methane rule for oil & gas. LDAR, flaring limits, zero-emission devices.
market_impact_summary: Increases producer compliance costs. May accelerate consolidation.

name: EPA Power Plant Carbon Rule
description: Requires coal plants: 90% CO2 reduction by 2032 or retire. New gas: CCS by 2035.
market_impact_summary: If upheld, accelerates coal retirement. Requires CCS for new baseload gas.

name: ERCOT Performance Credit Mechanism
description: Performance credits for dispatchable capacity during scarcity.
market_impact_summary: May support 3-10 GW new dispatchable. $1-2B/year generator revenue.

name: Clean Power Plan
description: First CO2 limits for existing power plants. 32% reduction by 2030. Stayed, then repealed.
market_impact_summary: Never implemented. Created planning uncertainty. Influenced utility decisions.

name: One Big Beautiful Bill Act
description: Sweeping tax and energy legislation that repeals/modifies most IRA clean energy provisions. Terminates EV credits, accelerates wind/solar phaseout, maintains nuclear/carbon capture support, creates Energy Dominance Financing Program.
market_impact_summary: Reduces renewable energy subsidies, supports fossil fuel development, slows clean energy deployment
notes: Signed by President Trump July 4, 2025. Replaces IRA as primary federal energy policy.
